Chapter 737: Chapter 26: The Unyielding Supreme Being (Subscription Request)_3

Chapter 737: Chapter 26: The Unyielding Supreme Being (Subscription Request)_3

…

Star Lord’s Great Hall.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

Suddenly.

Wisps of ethereal power began to converge.

“What is this?”

...

Lin Yuan quickly opened his eyes, “The Clan Suppression Weapon of our human civilization… The power of the Void Realm World?”

The Void Realm World, famed for being able to replicate anything, capable of mimicking the countless rules of the universe, combined with the ‘Land Beyond,’ significantly boosted the cultivation speed of Tenth Rank Evolvers of human civilization.

It was said that one of the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization, the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, acquired her Supreme Evolution Path from the Void Realm World.

The Void Realm World originated before human civilization’s long period of dormant years, during that unprecedented greatest opportunity, when countless treasures and heritages fell like rain into the universe.

Hum.

Threads of illusory power continued to gather and swirl, faintly outlining the complete image of a miniature two-dimensional world before Lin Yuan.

“So this is the true appearance of that two-dimensional world?” Lin Yuan observed carefully.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit of Lin Yuan delved into that two-dimensional world, and for him, it was difficult to fully sense the entirety of the two-dimensional world.

It was akin to the illusion of being deep in the mountains, unaware of the surroundings.

However, Lin Yuan now had a concrete concept of this two-dimensional world.

“The fundamental power of the two-dimensional world… So this is what it’s like?”

Lin Yuan observed closely, as the Taiyang Divine Spirit felt the true breath of the two-dimensional world within it, the direct experience reflecting off the complete two-dimensional world itself.

[Your aptitude is against the heavens, sensing the essence of the mysterious world’s power, your own accumulation is slowly growing…]

…

Compared to the Supreme Beings of human civilization, who could only sense the overall aura of the two-dimensional world individually, Lin Yuan’s Dao Primordial Spirit was within the two-dimensional world.

Comparing the two, his gains were much greater than those of the Supreme Beings.

“No, that’s not right…”

“How come I feel that the two-dimensional world replicated by the Void Realm World is incomplete, as if it’s just a portion?” Lin Yuan was slightly startled in his heart.

With the Taiyang Divine Spirit as a reference in the real two-dimensional world, Lin Yuan immediately realized that the two-dimensional world replicated by the Void Realm World was vaguely incomplete.

This was somewhat unbelievable to Lin Yuan.

Given the depth of the two-dimensional world, it was normal for the Void Realm World to be unable to replicate it completely.

The Xia Qin Supreme Being also specifically mentioned to Lin Yuan that the fidelity of the two-dimensional world replicated by the Void Realm World was only one-tenth to one-twentieth that of the true two-dimensional world.

But fidelity and completeness were two different matters.

For example, when trying to replicate a famous painting, the copy might come nowhere close to the original in terms of the details of the artistry.

But at least in terms of size, the copy should not be much different from the real painting.

Yet now, the two-dimensional world replicated by the Void Realm World seemed much smaller than the true two-dimensional world.

“There are two possibilities.”

“One is that I perceived it incorrectly.”

“The other is that within the two-dimensional world, there are vast hidden spaces that the Void Realm World cannot detect and thus cannot replicate.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

“That two-dimensional world…” Lin Yuan looked up in a certain direction, precisely the final resting place of the ‘White Paper.’

Around the ‘White Paper’, any matter would dematerialize on its own. If not for the intervention of a Supreme Being, likely one percent of this universe would turn into a scroll.

“Forget it.”

“What kind of secrets are hidden within that two-dimensional world, and what does it have to do with me?” Lin Yuan pondered for a moment, no longer dwelling on it. His most urgent task was to enhance his strength as much as possible.

Then, when the heavenly gate opens, defeat the other competitors, step out of the two-dimensional world, and return to the Main Universe.

…

Two-dimensional World.

Lin Yuan, while sensing the essence of heaven and earth, took out a silver mirror and gently stroked it.

“How exactly is this mirror used?”

Lin Yuan scrutinized it carefully. According to the information he had obtained, this silver mirror had belonged to a powerful member of the Ice Clan before it fell into the hands of the Tuoba Ancient God.

That Ice Clan powerhouse had possessed the mirror for decades and may have discovered some of its functions.

However, after dying at the hands of the Tuoba Ancient God, the true body of that Ice Clan member went into seclusion, and even Lin Yuan, concealing his identity, could not make contact.

“If blood doesn’t work, let’s try mental power.” Lin Yuan carefully extended a wisp of mental energy.

Within the two-dimensional world, even though all extraordinary powers were suppressed, mental energy, being the most fundamental force of life, stands apart from the physical strength and blood.

Even in this two-dimensional world, the presence of mental power was still allowed.

It was just like other extraordinary powers, mental energy was also greatly suppressed.

As a practitioner at the Witch Ancestor Nineteenth Realm, Lin Yuan had accumulated a fair amount of mental energy, allowing him the confidence to expend some on the mirror.

If it were other Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, the loss of a wisp of mental energy might lead to a decline in condition and a considerable reduction in strength.

“Hmm?”

“Is this mirror absorbing mental energy?”

Lin Yuan’s spirit was lifted as his mental energy came into contact with the mirror surface, experiencing a slight pull.

Just as Lin Yuan was about to expend part of his mental energy to figure out the purpose of the silver mirror once and for all, Zha Ran Gu appeared outside, wanting to see Lin Yuan.

“Come in.”

Lin Yuan put away the silver mirror and said.

“Master.”

Zha Ran Gu spoke respectfully.

“What’s the matter?”

Lin Yuan looked at Zha Ran Gu. Before going into seclusion, he had instructed that he should not be disturbed unless it was important.

“The royal family of Xueyu Ancient Country wants to meet with the master…” Zha Ran Gu quickly said.

“The royal family of Xueyu Ancient Country?” Lin Yuan shook his head and said, “I’m not interested.”

If it had been at the beginning when he first arrived, Lin Yuan might have been quite wary of the royal family of Xueyu Ancient Country.

But now? Not to mention the royal family of Xueyu Ancient Country, even if the royal families of the twelve Ancient Countries stood together, Lin Yuan wouldn’t bat an eyelid.

“The royal family of Xueyu Ancient Country says they have a precious treasure to present.” Zha Ran Gu added.

“A precious treasure?” Lin Yuan’s heart suddenly stirred.
